---
title: "Annexin-induced membrane curvature"
description: "Annexin organization on an anionic membrane and the associated membrane-curvature response."
order: 7
---

Human Annexin A4 binds to an anionic membrane and participates in membrane-remodelling processes associated with membrane repair.
